metadata.evidence: Managed Maya 2024 reused healthy PID 15000, forced a fresh unsaved scene, and reached product code. Locator deformation-follow passed, then the smoke raised 'Rivet child did not follow locator.' The implementation and legacy Scene_Pattern_Rivet.py both parentConstraint locator -> child offset with maintainOffset=True; the failing equality assertion incorrectly required child world position to equal locator world position instead of preserving the initial offset while matching locator motion delta.
metadata.diagnosis: Smoke-oracle defect, not rivet primitive defect. Legacy behavior explicitly uses parentConstraint(loc, offset, mo=True).
